title: EVA: Evidence-seeking Visual Agent for Hallucination-Resistant Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33706v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often arise from visual assumptions that go unchecked. Self-reflection, multi-agent debate, and counterfactual verification can reinforce erroneous conclusions when they rely on the same unverified visual assumptions. External visual tools can provide verifiable evidence, but models may select the wrong tools, supply incorrect parameters, or ignore or contradict the evidence they obtain. In this work, we propose EVA, an Evidence-seeking Visual Agent that reframes multimodal reasoning as an explicit process of evidence acquisition and verification. At the core of EVA is a unified evidence-grounded execution pipeline designed to address the above challenges through two tightly coupled mechanisms. tldr: EVA提出了一种证据寻求式视觉智能体框架，将多模态推理重构为明确的证据获取与验证过程，通过迭代式工具重规划等紧密耦合的机制，从根源上减少多模态大语言模型的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: EVA proposes an evidence-seeking visual agent framework that reframes multimodal reasoning as an explicit process of evidence acquisition and verification, leveraging tightly coupled mechanisms such as iterative tool replanning to fundamentally reduce hallucinations in multimodal large language models.
